tasks.label: Run Android Full
tasks.command: adb logcat -c; .\gradlew installMobileOnlyDebug; if ($?) { adb shell monkey -p com.garethevans.church.opensongtablet -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $appPid = adb shell pidof com.garethevans.church.opensongtablet; adb logcat --pid=$appPid
